title: Gas Kiln Firing (High Fire)
source_quote:
Studio Kiln Facilities
Back Door Pottery recently upgraded its Cone 10 gas kiln used for high-temperature firings.
evidence_sentence: Back Door Pottery offers high-temperature firings in a recently upgraded Cone 10 gas car kiln that accommodates large sculptural pieces.
evidence_quote: Back Door Pottery recently upgraded its Cone 10 gas kiln used for high-temperature firings. Built as a car kiln, the floor rolls out on tracks, making it easier to load both large sculptural pieces and smaller pottery.
how_to_join: Contact the studio to schedule a kiln firing in advance.
summary: Back Door Pottery offers Cone 10 gas kiln firing for high-temperature work on a car kiln that opens for easy loading. Contact the studio to schedule; pricing not stated on the pages.
